list.name: run
list.label: run
list.query: SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY started_at DESC

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, value FROM metrics WHERE run_id = '$run' AND name = 'coverage_ratio' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, value FROM metrics WHERE run_id = '$run' AND name = 'transfer_bytes' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS time, node_id AS metric, value FROM metrics WHERE run_id = '$run' AND name = 'latency_ms' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time, node_id, kind, payload FROM events WHERE run_id = '$run' AND kind LIKE '%fail%' AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION ALL SELECT ts, 'writer', kind, jsonb_build_object('dropped', dropped) FROM dropped_metrics WHERE run_id = '$run' ORDER BY 1 DESC
